context.person: A person using a peer-to-peer marketplace
context.user_goal: Check the original card after five business days and contact support if the credit is absent.

product_state.preceding_state: A seller approved a full refund after an item was not shipped.
product_state.current_state: The refund amount is $82.40. The marketplace sent the refund to the original card today.
known_facts: The marketplace sent the refund to the original card today.
The bank may take three to five business days to post it.
The canceled order cannot be reopened.
forbidden_claims: The money is already visible in the bank account.
The refund can be redirected to another card.
The order can still be shipped.

challenge: Rewrite the in-product confirmation so the person can understand marketplace seller refund issued, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: The marketplace completed its refund action, but bank posting remains pending.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Check the original card after five business days and contact support if the credit is absent.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
